title: Path-Aligned Constraint Equivariance
abstract: arXiv:2611.22873v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learned super-resolution of physical fields must satisfy structural constraints---such as divergence-free flow ($\nabla\cdot u=0$), curl-free fields ($\nabla\times u=0$), and pointwise sum-to-one normalization ($1^\top p=1$)---that standard training objectives do not enforce. Soft penalties trade fidelity against satisfaction via a scalar hyperparameter $\lambda$ but cannot drive the residual to zero; hard-constrained regression eliminates the residual by construction yet converges to the conditional mean, losing small-scale spectral structure. We observe that in Conditional Flow Matching with linear paths, a linear constraint $Ax=c$ is preserved along the entire transport trajectory whenever the velocity field is compatible ($Av_\theta=0$) and the initial noise is consistent ($Ax_0=c$); along the trajectory, the latter two conditions are also necessary. translated_abstract: 物理场的学习式超分辨率必须满足结构性约束——例如无散度流场（∇·u=0）、无旋度场（∇×u=0）以及逐点分量之和为一的归一化（1^T p=1）——而标准训练目标无法强制这些约束。软惩罚方法通过标量超参数 λ 在保真度与约束满足之间进行权衡，但无法将残差降为零；硬约束回归虽在构造上消除了残差，却会收敛到条件均值，从而丢失小尺度谱结构。我们观察到，在采用线性路径的条件流匹配中，只要速度场与约束相容（Av_θ=0）且初始噪声满足约束（Ax_0=c），线性约束 Ax=c 就会在整条传输轨迹上得以保持；并且沿着轨迹，这两个条件也是必要的。我们将这一原理称为路径等变性原理，并将其实现为 PACE（Path-Aligned Constraint Equivariance，路径对齐约束等变性）……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“路径等变性”原理及其实现 PACE：在采用线性路径的条件流匹配中，只要速度场与线性约束相容且初始噪声满足该约束，无散度、无旋度、归一化等物理约束即可沿整条生成轨迹被精确保持，从而以硬约束方式实现超分辨率且不损失小尺度谱结构。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes the path-equivariance principle and its implementation PACE: in Conditional Flow Matching with linear paths, linear physical constraints (e.g., divergence-free, curl-free, sum-to-one normalization) are preserved exactly along the entire trajectory whenever the velocity field is compatible and the initial noise is consistent, enabling hard-constrained super-resolution without sacrificing small-scale spectral structure.
